moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to launch this Saturday, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe joining the judging panel.

angles.name: Launch Night Buzz
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is back this Saturday for its 24th series, with Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe stepping into new hosting roles. Who are you rooting for already? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts Excitement
angles.copy: Big changes in the ballroom! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe take over the Strictly hosting reins this weekend. Get ready for glitz, glamour, and a fresh new feel.

moments.title: Bake Off is Back!
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off begins next Tuesday, with Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding returning to the tent alongside Paul Hollywood and new judge Nigella Lawson.

angles.name: Tent Reopens
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns next Tuesday. Expect soggy bottoms, Hollywood handshakes, and a fresh batch of bakers.

angles.name: New Judge Focus
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent as a new judge next week! How do you think she'll fare with the bakers' creations?

moments.title: Prince Harry Turns 42
moments.blurb: Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex, celebrates his 42nd birthday today, September 15th.

angles.name: Royal Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing Prince Harry, the Duke of Sussex, a very happy 42nd birthday today! Hope he's having a great one.

moments.title: Nick Jonas Turns 34
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Nick Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers, celebrates his 34th birthday tomorrow, September 16th.

angles.name: Jonas Brother's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 34th birthday to Nick Jonas tomorrow! From Jonas Brothers to solo star, what's your favourite Nick track?

moments.title: Anastacia Turns 58
moments.blurb: The 'I'm Outta Love' powerhouse vocalist Anastacia celebrates her 58th birthday on Thursday, September 17th.

angles.name: Sprock Queen Birthday
angles.copy: The incredible Anastacia turns 58 this Thursday! What's your go-to song from the 'little lady with the big voice'?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday, September 21st.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 on Monday! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

moments.title: Andrea Bocelli Turns 68
moments.blurb: World-renowned Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli celebrates his 68th birthday next Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Tenor's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday next Tuesday to the incredible Andrea Bocelli! His voice is pure magic.

moments.title: Billie Piper Turns 44
moments.blurb: English actress and former pop singer Billie Piper, known for her early hits and 'Doctor Who', celebrates her 44th birthday next Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Star to Actress
angles.copy: Happy 44th birthday next Tuesday to the multi-talented Billie Piper! From pop charts to 'Doctor Who', what's your favourite Billie era?

moments.title: Julio Iglesias Turns 83
moments.blurb: Spanish music legend Julio Iglesias, one of the best-selling artists of all time, celebrates his 83rd birthday next Wednesday, September 23rd.

angles.name: Latin Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday next Wednesday to the iconic Julio Iglesias! His romantic ballads have captivated millions worldwide.

moments.title: Will Smith Turns 58
moments.blurb: Actor and Grammy-winning rapper Will Smith celebrates his 58th birthday next Friday, September 25th.

angles.name: Fresh Prince's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Friday, Will Smith turns 58! From West Philadelphia born and raised, to Hollywood superstar and music icon. What's your favourite Will Smith movie or song?
